messages:
support_carla: Heads-up: customer acme-inc hit p99 latency ~3.2s on /v1/generate after the continuous-batcher change rolled at 03:05 UTC. They pasted prometheus p99 spikes and are pretty upset (ticket #INC-9421). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/acme/incidents/9421 :grimacing:

ashok: saw the alert earlier. Which config rolled?

support_carla: rolled grace_window=12ms, hold_timeout_ms=18, target_batch=16 (canary to 20% infra). Before it was grace_window=6ms, hold_timeout_ms=8, target_batch=8.

jc: @ashok can you pull the tail logs for the pool that serves acme tenant? suspect small payloads getting coalesced with large ones -> KV cache thrash + extra scheduling.

srebot: Alert: p99_rtf_requests{tenant="acme-inc"} > 2.5s for 6m; error_rate unchanged. ConfigChange detected by deploybot at 1743600300.

ashok: grabbing logs. quick note: auth headers are fine, no 5xx. It's latency-only.

maria_devex: any repro steps from support? can prod-replay reproduce?

support_carla: acme provided a short repro: lots of tiny prompts (~8-20 tokens) at 250rps with occasional long prompts (~300 tokens) burst. They see p95 normal but p99 jumps. They added a curl example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"input":"short"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate`

ashok: logs from node gpod-07: we have many tiny requests getting coalesced into big batches. When a long prompt arrives it holds the KV cache while decoding -> increases decode tail. snippet from runtime trace: `batch_wait: 16ms -> model_run: 2.9s (long seq)`

ashok: config we rolled pushes target_batch up and hold_timeout slightly higher — that helps throughput but worsens tail under mixed-length traffic.

jc: immediate mitigation: can we push a per-tenant override to lower grace_window and max_batch for acme-inc (or opt them out of continuous coalesce)?

ops_kyle: I can hotpatch routing policy. propose: set tenant_override.acme-inc = {continuous_coalesce: false, max_batch: 8, hold_timeout_ms: 6} for the traffic class. Rolling in 60s if no objections.

maria_devex: :+1: also suggest we enable the small-payload fast-path for that pool (avoid KV blocking).

ashok: quick repro locally with loadgen: mixed generator (90% 12-token, 10% 300-token) reproduces p99 spike when target_batch >= 12. With target_batch=8 p99 drops from ~2.6s to ~0.9s.

support_carla: customer wants root cause and timeline. I told them we're triaging and will apply temporary override.

jc: longer-term: add adaptive batching heuristics that detect high variance in seq_len and prefer smaller batches or isolated lanes. Add queueing priority for tiny prompts.

maria_devex: also add a guard in rollout: if p99 for any tenant increases > 30% within 30m after batch-config change -> auto-rollout pause and revert flag. We've had repeated surprises.

ops_kyle: hotpatch applied to edge routing for acme-inc at 1743604200. Confirming: continuous_coalesce=false, max_batch=8, hold_timeout_ms=6.

srebot: Deploy event: tenant_override updated by ops_kyle at 1743604200.

ashok: post-hotpatch metrics (gpod-07): p99 for acme down from 3200ms -> 930ms within 90s. CPU up ~8% but within headroom.

support_carla: relayed to customer, they reported noticeable improvement and downgraded severity. Keeping ticket open for RCA.

jc: please capture the experiment configs and attach to INC-9421. We should also add a perf-test into CI that simulates mixed-length workloads on continuous-batcher changes.

maria_devex: repro steps summary for INC-9421:
```
1) Launch loadgen: 250rps, 90% short (12 tok), 10% long (300 tok)
2) Apply continuous-batcher config: target_batch=16, grace_window=12ms, hold_timeout_ms=18ms
3) Measure p95/p99 on tenant queue for 10m
```

maria_devex: Suggested rollback patch for config repo (yaml snippet):
```yaml
continuous_batcher:
  default:
    target_batch: 16
    grace_window_ms: 12
    hold_timeout_ms: 18
  tenant_overrides:
    acme-inc:
      enabled: false
      max_batch: 8
      hold_timeout_ms: 6
```

jc: action items:
- ashok: capture runtime traces + sampling traces for 5x affected nodes -> attach to INC-9421 (ETA 2h)
- ops_kyle: keep tenant override until we ship adaptive-batching (ETA 2w)
- devex/maria: add mixed-length perf test to PR checks (ETA 1w)
- product: consider conservative rollout guard (maria to raise PR)

support_carla: thanks all, I'll update customer and close in next update once traces uploaded.

ashok: uploading traces now to INC-9421, will ping when done.

ops_kyle: leaving override in place and monitoring; will lower further if we see more tail.

srebot: Note: follow-up check scheduled at 1743607800 to verify p99 stability.

support_carla: stamping this thread into the ticket. nice quick fix team :heart:
